name: codex-mcp-bridge
description: A policy-enforcing Streamable HTTP MCP bridge from ChatGPT to local Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your local Codex
interface.longDescription: Run and monitor local Codex tasks from ChatGPT through a policy-enforcing MCP bridge. Reuse agents across activities, choose models and reasoning effort, and control working folders and filesystem access.
capabilities: Run and continue local Codex tasks
Control working folders and access policy
defaultPrompt: Ask local Codex to inspect this project and explain how it works.
Use local Codex to implement this change and track the activity.
Show the status of my active Codex agents and activities.
